sv.title: Här bryter hon mot omtalade regeln: ”Ser på hennes ansikte”
sv.summary: Susan Külm bröt mot den omtalade nya regeln i skidskyttet. Hon diskades efter sitt förbjudna tilltag på skjutvallen. – Man ser i hennes ansikte att hon förstår sitt misstag, säger experten Björn Ferry.

en.title: Here she breaks the much-discussed rule: "Look at her face"
en.summary: Susan Külm broke the much-discussed new rule in biathlon. She was disqualified after her prohibited move at the shooting range. – You can see in her face that she understands her mistake, says expert Björn Ferry.
